title: Double Drip 10K Blue Razz Lemonade Prefilled Vape Pods + Refill
description: Designed for use with the Double Drip 10K Prefilled Pod Kit, this Pod & Refill Pack offers an easy, refill-free way to keep your device running smoothly. Each pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml refill bottle of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, delivering up to 10,000 puffs per kit (depending on usage) with reliably smooth vapour and full flavour. Blue Razz Lemonade blends the juicy tang of Blue Raspberry with the zesty sparkle of Lemonade for a fizzy, sweet-and-sour fruit vape that stays punchy from start to finish. When it’s time to swap out your pod and refill, just insert the new ones and let the auto-refill system handle the rest. Simple, mess-free and satisfying, this pack is perfect for topping up your favourite flavour or extending your device’s lifespan.
